title: One Law, and a Witness That Runs Backwards
description:
A synthesis of two independently-run hardware programmes, with one dedicated run of its own. Its contribution is that the two programmes measured the same law, and that reading that law on a MARGINAL -- as the relational-time literature does -- produces an observable which is not merely uninformative about entanglement but suppressed by it.

One law. cos(theta/2) is the overlap between two qubit states separated by Bloch angle theta. Both programmes measure coherence surviving as a product of those overlaps, one factor per party that has acquired distinguishing information. twisted-spin-ptm measures it against COUPLING ANGLE (T_xx = cos(chi_t/2)^(N-2), the exponent counting N-2 bulk spins); relational-time-ibm-quantum measures the same overlap against TIME (rho_C = cos((t-t')pi/d)) and environment coupling. Exact, not analogical: adjacent clock records at d=8 overlap at 0.923880 and cos(pi/4 / 2) = 0.923880.

The witness runs backwards. For a bipartite pure state the marginal entropy IS the entanglement entropy, so entanglement is exactly what mixes the clock marginal and flattens the distribution the witness reads. Evaluated exactly, a zero-entanglement product state scores HIGHER than the maximally entangled history state at every clock dimension: 0.500 vs 0.000 at d=2, 0.750 vs 0.177 at d=4, 0.875 vs 0.497 at d=8. The d=4 ratio is 0.750/0.176777 = 4.24, which reproduces the 4.2x that the relational-time programme's IBM-2 adversarial run measured on hardware. The adversary did not exploit a loophole; it saturated a quantity that entanglement necessarily suppresses.

Measured on hardware. The anti-correlation was derived here and then tested: a purpose-built sweep on ibm_marrakesh (IBM-11, 53 circuits, two qubits, 9/9 pre-registered gates) measured the marginal witness and CHSH on the same states from a product state to a Bell pair, finding r = -0.9573. The state maximising the witness produced CHSH = 1.8605, BELOW the classical bound, at the same point; the state maximising CHSH (2.6565) had a witness of 0.0100. The exact trade-off S^2 + 16W^2 survived as structure rather than value, flat to 0.1507 against a 1.1390 band at 0.891 attenuation -- flatter than the noise model predicted. The anti-correlation was not guaranteed to survive: it is forced for pure states, where marginal entropy is entanglement entropy, but hardware states are mixed and that identity fails. The same run measured Svozil's synchronisation excess reproduced by a zero-entanglement product state to within 0.006 while CHSH separated the same states by 0.80.

Two exact nulls. Each programme has a structural zero that was predicted, pre-registered and confirmed on hardware. At chi_t = pi the OAT boundary observable reads 0.000000 on a state that is I/4 with concurrence 0, SEPARABLE. At d = 2 the relational-time witness reads 0.000000 on a Bell pair carrying 1.0000 ebits, MAXIMALLY ENTANGLED. Both have maximally mixed marginals, which is the mechanism. The two observables are not the same functional -- a joint correlator (T_xx) separates these states at 0 versus +1 while the marginal witness cannot -- so what the programmes share is the law and an exact null, with twisted-spin-ptm's null supplying the separable state.

Independent convergence. Svozil (arXiv:2512.09100) builds a relational clock from a singlet and reaches the same wall from a fourth direction: individual marginal tick rates remain 1/2 and carry nothing, so temporal structure exists only in the joint coincidence record, certified device-independently by a CHSH violation.

Certification threshold. Both programmes resolved it the same way and neither anticipated the other's version: V_Q over Haar-random settings, and a multi-setting fidelity witness exceeding the exact separable bound. Certification requires agreement across incompatible measurements.

Applied bounds. The line began with two engineering questions about moving information off a spacecraft, both now answered negatively: Holevo and superdense coding bound the payload so compression must be earned classically before encoding, and relativistic time dilation trades local throughput for Earth-frame storage rather than accelerating computation, at gamma-1 ~ 1e-10 in practice.

Claim boundary: no new measurements; nothing about quantum electrodynamics (no gauge field, photon or vacuum appears in either programme); nothing about whether time in nature is emergent. Both states are prepared by externally timed gates and both clock/system splits are imposed rather than derived. Not peer-reviewed.
notes: Synthesis of two companion programmes; contains no new measurements. Research supported with Cloud TPUs from Google's TPU Research Cloud (TRC); the companion programmes' hardware experiments used separate IBM Quantum Open Plan access.
